text:
Ben Torres: Hi team  day 1! Two quick things: I accepted the org invite but I cant open the "Redwood Product Kit" file in Figma (it shows access request). Also where do we keep the design research consent template and participant payment flow?

Priya Shah: welcome Ben!! :wave: I just sent you an Okta invite and added you to the 'Designers' group. If Figma still blocks you, log in via Okta SSO, then open the invite link. Figma sometimes links to personal accounts.

Ben Torres: Okta shows me as active. Still seeing "Request access" on the Product Kit.

Dina (design-onboarding-bot): Ben Torres has been provisioned to groups: Designers, Prototyping, Design-System-Editors.

Marco Diaz: Hey Ben  Im your PM. Roadmap and PRDs are in Notion under /product/strategy. For design-specific docs we keep a curated index at Notion > Design > Team Home. Ill drop access in 5 if you dont have it.

Priya Shah: If Request Access persists, try this quick checklist:
1) Confirm youre signed in to Figma with your work email (not personal).
2) Open the invite link from your SSO session (not from email client preview).
3) Clear cookies or use a private window if you have conflicting accounts.
If none work, paste a screenshot here and Ill force-add you to the file.

Ben Torres: Screenshot attached (shows Request access on Product Kit).

Priya Shah: Got it. Force-added you to that file and to "Redwood Product Kit" team. Try now.

Ben Torres: That did it, I can open it. Thanks! Quick follow-up: where is the participant payment process? We ran a study at my last company where ops handled payments; want to make sure I follow Redwood's process.

Zoe Li: Hi Ben  I handle research ops. Payments are via Stripe Connect; we run payments through the Research payments board in Notion (Research > Ops). For external testers we use SendWaves for gift cards; for recruited testers we invoice via Ops. Before running a study, submit a Payment Request in the Research Ops page and tag me.

Ben Torres: Cool. And consent templates?

Zoe Li: Templates are in Notion > Research > Templates. Theres a short form for remote unmoderated and a longer consent for moderated sessions. Always include the data retention clause. If the study includes session recording, we use the specific recording consent checkbox.

Priya Shah: Also note: design handoff template is a Figma file called "Handoff Template (Design)" in the Product Kit. It includes the spec checklist we use for engineers: token mapping, export slices, interaction notes, and a QA checklist.

Ben Torres: Where do I find the handoff .md template for PRD reference? I prefer to link the PRD to the Figma file.

Marco Diaz: PRD templates are in Notion > Product Templates. We usually include a link to the Figma prototype under the "Design Assets" section and add a dev assignee at time of spec finalization.

Zoe Li: For research shadowing: we run a weekly "Observe & Debrief" every Thurs at 4pm. New designers usually join the first two sessions. Also we have a recorded repo of past sessions in Lookback (internal). I can add you to Lookback and share the playback links.

Ben Torres: Would like to sit in on a session. Thu 4pm works.

Priya Shah: FYI: If you need a mac loaner for prototyping, fill the Hardware Checkout form in #people-ops and well reserve one. Also make sure you have the Figma desktop app installed for local prototype recording.

Dina (design-onboarding-bot): Ben Torres added to Lookback, Product Kit file, and Design Standup calendar.

Ben Torres: Thanks all. One last tiny ask  is there a checklist for first-week deliverables for designers? I want to make sure I hit expected onboarding milestones.

Priya Shah: Yep, Notion > Product Onboarding has a "Designer 30-60-90" checklist (tasks like read design system, complete two pairing sessions, run your first micro-usability test). Ill assign the first-week items to you and DM the list.

Marco Diaz: Welcome aboard! Excited to collaborate. If you want a quick walkthrough of our Q2 OKRs for the product team, ping me and Ill drop a short call.

Ben Torres: Appreciate it  will DM if anything else pops up. Excited to be here!
